appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'. This text explicitly describes an increasing trend.
A single blue line graph traces production values over time. The line starts high on the left, dips in the middle, rises to a peak, and then levels off towards the right.
The vertical Y-axis is labeled 'Production' and has tick marks ranging from 0 to 3,000 in increments of 200.
The horizontal X-axis is labeled 'Year' and displays tick marks for the years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.

printed_facts.fact: Axis label is 'Year'. Visible tick labels are 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The line begins at the year 2018 at a production value of approximately 2,800.
The line drops to its lowest point at the year 2019, at a production value of approximately 2,400.
The line rises to its highest point at the year 2020, at a production value of approximately 2,850.
The line drops to a production value of approximately 2,550 at the year 2021.
The line remains nearly flat at a production value of approximately 2,550 to 2,575 at the year 2022.
The line ends at the year 2023 at a production value of approximately 2,500.
